purpose: Archived Sol-high draft retained for provenance. Its scientific-risk and proxy-validity annotations are not the current Chapter 1 runtime gold.
superseded_reason: The 2026-08-09 architecture clarification narrowed Chapter 1 evaluation to role handoff, plan/action/observation consistency, graph materialization, terminal state, artifact closure, and local recovery. Rich remote-sensing scientific-risk and claim-validity annotations are Chapter 2 candidates and must not be used to define Chapter 1 runtime success.

fixed_modern_context.raster_contract: Sentinel-2, 10 m, EPSG:32650, 10 described bands: B2,B3,B4,B5,B6,B7,B8,B8A,B11,B12

action_vocabulary.execute: The fixed data and current authorized tool families are sufficient, subject to stated parameters and validation.
action_vocabulary.ask_or_downgrade: The request needs a scientific definition, extra input, or an explicitly weaker proxy before execution.
action_vocabulary.controlled_stop: The requested claim is not supported by the fixed data/tool context and must not be presented as completed.

researcher_review_priorities.decision: Whether a transparent but uncalibrated index-threshold proxy may be admitted directly, or must first receive user acceptance.
researcher_review_priorities.current_draft_policy: Prefer execute only when the runtime explicitly labels the threshold and output as a proxy; ask_or_downgrade remains acceptable.
researcher_review_priorities.why_signoff_matters: Changing this policy moves three cases between execute and ask, materially changing the headline admission rate.

researcher_review_priorities.decision: Whether an absent registered NDSI operator is a controlled-stop condition or authorizes task-specific formula glue code.
researcher_review_priorities.current_draft_policy: Treat the 18-tool catalog as the authorized execution boundary and stop or ask; do not silently reimplement a missing standardized index.

researcher_review_priorities.decision: Whether the standard vegetation false-colour convention may be declared by the system without a user clarification turn.
researcher_review_priorities.current_draft_policy: Allow execution with the B8/B4/B3 convention disclosed in provenance.

must_not_claim: A band combination was scientifically verified if stack positions were only guessed.
tasks.audit_note: Keep the original wording. Declare the selected false-colour convention.

must_not_claim: B8/B4 semantics when using unchecked 1-based stack positions.
tasks.audit_note: Keep. This is a clean supported positive case.

must_not_claim: NDSI was produced by substituting another registered index.
tasks.audit_note: The data can support NDSI, but the current 18-tool catalog has no authorized NDSI operator. Preserve as a missing-capability case.

must_not_claim: Water classification accuracy from an unvalidated threshold.
tasks.audit_note: Keep. Distinguish an NDWI map from a validated water mask.

must_not_claim: Default band numbers are valid without metadata resolution.
tasks.audit_note: Keep. This is a clean supported positive case after band resolution is fixed.

must_not_claim: Vegetation thresholding alone identifies cropland.
tasks.audit_note: Do not repair the prompt into an easy NDVI task. Preserve it as a scientific-boundary case.

must_not_claim: A binary NDVI proxy is fractional vegetation cover without calibration.
tasks.audit_note: Keep. Require the result to be labelled as a declared proxy when appropriate.

must_not_claim: A raw spectral-index threshold is a validated impervious-surface map.
tasks.audit_note: Current tools lack NDBI/IBI and a validated classifier. A proxy requires explicit user acceptance.

must_not_claim: Small-water or shadow discrimination was validated without reference data.
tasks.audit_note: Keep as a supported index-to-mask case with explicit limitations.

must_not_claim: Sentinel-2 reflectance bands provide direct land-surface temperature.
tasks.audit_note: A high-value scientific precondition case: the modern fixed raster has no thermal band, even though a generic calculate_lst tool is registered.

must_not_claim: Area or cover rate computed from degree units or nodata counted as non-vegetation.
tasks.audit_note: Keep as the strongest supported multi-step positive case.

must_not_claim: All four requested layers were completed when NDBI or layer composition is missing.
tasks.audit_note: The original prompt omits location/date and relies on inherited context. Current tools support only part of the requested workflow.

must_not_claim: NDVI alone is a complete measure of vegetation health.
tasks.audit_note: Keep the ambiguity: it tests unresolved-question handling. NDVI/EVI may be offered only as declared proxies.

must_not_claim: NDBI, albedo, or reflectance alone demonstrates urban heat-island hotspots.
tasks.audit_note: Requires thermal data and a reference/background definition; the fixed Sentinel-2 raster is insufficient.

must_not_claim: Generic edges or low-NDVI pixels constitute a road network.
tasks.audit_note: Sentinel-2 at 10 m and the current tool catalog are insufficient for a reliable urban road network.

must_not_claim: The supplied polygon defines 'near' without an agreed buffer or analysis zone.
tasks.audit_note: The grammar may later be normalized, but the substantive missing buffer definition must remain visible. Current tools lack the spatial subsetting operation.

must_not_claim: A water index from one date is a floodwater-accumulation potential model.
tasks.audit_note: Preserve as a missing-data and inappropriate-proxy case.

must_not_claim: Spectral flatness means terrain flatness or emergency suitability.
tasks.audit_note: The prompt also relies on inherited scene context. It is a strong compound-constraint stop case.

must_not_claim: Non-built pixels are automatically valid open space.
tasks.audit_note: Requires class definitions and a land-cover method absent from the current tool catalog.

must_not_claim: A single-date NDVI association demonstrates heat-island mitigation caused by greening.
tasks.audit_note: Preserve as the strongest scientific-claim boundary case; it belongs to stop/escalate under the fixed Chapter 1 context.
